entries.answer:
Claude Opus 5 (max) — Context: 1M tokens total, max output 128K. Bestplaced benchmarks: FrontierCode 1.1 Extended 63.6% (best verified score), ARCAGI3 30.2% (best verified score)[1][2]

 Claude Fable 5 — Context: 1M tokens. Bestplaced benchmarks: SWEbench Pro 80.0%, FrontierSWE 88.8%[3][4][5][6]

 GPT5.6 Sol (max) — Context: ~1.05M tokens. Bestplaced benchmarks: BrowseComp 92.2%, OSWorld 2.0 62.6%, TerminalBench 2.1 88.8%, DeepSWE v1.1 72.7% (also 73.0% in xAI table)[2][7][8]

 Grok 4.6 (xhigh) — Context: 500K tokens, no output cap stated. Bestplaced benchmarks: GDPValAA v2 1,753 Elo, AABriefcase 1,577 Elo, Harvey LAB 15.8%[8][9][10]

 Kimi K3 (max) — Context: 1,048,576 tokens. Bestplaced benchmarks: TerminalBench 2.1 88.3%, DeepSWE v1.1 67.5%, FrontierSWE 81.2%[11][12][13]

 GLM5.3 (max) — Context: 1M tokens, max output 128K. Bestplaced benchmarks: TerminalBench 3.0 28.3%, PostTrainBench 39.8%, AutomationBench v1.0.6 48.2%, CyberGym 84.5%, ExploitGym 105/130, ExploitBench 54.4%[12][14][15]

 Qwen3.8 Max — Context: 1M tokens (991K max input / 131K max output). Bestplaced benchmarks: PaperBench 93.0%, OSWorldVerified 86.1%, RealWorldQA 88.0%[16][17]

 Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B — Context: native 262,144, extensible to ~1,010,000; max output 131,072. No confirmed firstplace benchmark vs. the other listed models found in sources.[18][19]

 Muse Spark 1.2 (xhigh) — Context: 1M input, 1M max output. Bestplaced benchmarks: Humanity's Last Exam 45.5%, SciCode 56.4%, LCR (longcontext reasoning) 83.3%[20]

 Gemini 3.7 Flash (high) — Context: 1,048,576 tokens input, 65,536 max output. Bestplaced benchmarks: GDMMRCR v2 (8needle) 97.0%, WebDev Arena 1,588 Elo[21][22]

 DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max) — Context: 1M tokens, max output 384K. Bestplaced benchmarks: NL2Repo 61.1%, LiveCodeBench 93.5%, Codeforces rating 3,206, Apex Shortlist Pass@1 90.2%, MRCR 1M 83.5%, CorpusQA 1M 62.0%[23][24][12]

 Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) — Context: native 262,144, extensible to 1M via YaRN. Bestplaced benchmarks: IFBench 79.5%, SWEbench Pro 61.7%, OSWorldVerified 84.3%, AndroidWorld 81.9%, LiveCodeBench v6 90.3%, MathVision 90.0%[25][26]

 Motif 3 — Context: 262,144 tokens. Bestplaced benchmark: ITBench 51.5%[27][28]

 MiniMaxM3 — Context: 1M tokens (per MiniMax/API cards; NVIDIA NeMo lists 512K for the VLM variant). Bestplaced benchmarks: GPQA Diamond 92.9%, IFBench 82.9%, TerminalBench Hard 42.4%[29][30]

 DeepSeek V4 Pro (max) — Context: 1M tokens, max output 384K. Bestplaced benchmarks: LiveCodeBench 93.5%, Codeforces rating 3,206, Apex Shortlist Pass@1 90.2%, MRCR 1M 83.5%, CorpusQA 1M 62.0%[24][31][23]

 MiMoV2.5Pro — Context: 1,048,576 tokens. Bestplaced benchmarks: ranked 1 among opensource models on GDPValAA and ClawEval; leads longcontext retrieval at 512K/1M tokens (0.56 BFS/0.92 Parents at 512K)[32][33][34]

 Inkling — Context: native 1M tokens (hosted Tinker service currently exposes 64K/256K). No confirmed firstplace benchmark vs. the other listed models found in sources.[35]

 Hy3 — Context: 256K tokens (262,144), max output ~131K. Bestplaced benchmark: τ²Bench 92.7%[36][37]

 Ling 3.0 Flash — Context: 262,144 tokens, max output 16K. No confirmed firstplace benchmark vs. the other listed models found in sources.[38][39]
